7464.title: Computer Use permission rejection
7464.rootCauseOneLine: Computer Use schema failures collapse to an unsupported interaction and a Decline-only card; the original Windows request's rejected field remains unknown.
7464.proposedFix: Obtain privacy-safe validation-path diagnostics for the original native Windows request before changing consent validation; preserve fail-closed behavior.
7464.caveats: Two clean trusted-base runs verify the synthetic request-to-renderer rejection mechanism, not a valid native Windows request. No Windows host or raw request was available; browser screenshot capture was unavailable because Chromium is absent.
